subject.title: fix(grep): bound file reads with size cap in default grep operations

question: Should default grep context rendering deliberately omit context for regular files larger than 50 MiB, or should OpenClaw preserve context through a bounded/streaming extraction path?
rationale: The patch prevents an unbounded memory read, but the selected fixed threshold changes observable grep output for existing large files; source and tests cannot determine the intended long-term user contract.

options.title: Approve fixed-cap degradation
options.body: Keep the 50 MiB bound and document that oversized matching files retain the match but render as unreadable for context.

options.title: Require bounded context extraction
options.body: Pause this PR and design a reader that obtains only the requested lines for large matching files without loading the full file.

recommendation.title: Approve fixed-cap degradation
recommendation.body: Keep the 50 MiB bound and document that oversized matching files retain the match but render as unreadable for context.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for a core agent-session behavior contract decision.
